# Clavis Encrypt 3.15.1

## Improvements

- **Removing your license while offline no longer uses up a device.** If you choose **Settings → Remove license** without an internet connection, Clavis now frees that PC's activation the next time it starts online, so you can use your key on another PC.
- Clavis Pro and Premium keys are now confirmed each time Clavis starts while online, instead of once a day. With no internet connection, nothing changes and your plan keeps working.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download the new installer from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Microsoft Store:** the Store updates it automatically.
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
